typesense:trending.greeting:
*You find an odd box while doing some spring cleaning, the intricate box immediately catching your attention. There's golden text along its sides reading: "18+, 2-10 players, take turns drawing cards until all cards are gone or all players have quit. Place a card face-up to accept and face-down to reject."*

*The box is a simple wood, with stars painted along it. Holding it induces an odd compulsion to spread word of its existence and play.*
typesense:trending.name: Transformation Cards
typesense:trending.title: You find an odd box while doing some spring cleaning.

title_i18n.de: Du findest eine seltsame Kiste beim Frühjahrsputz.
title_i18n.es: Encuentras una caja extraña mientras haces la limpieza de primavera.
title_i18n.fr: Vous trouvez une boîte étrange en faisant le grand nettoyage de printemps.
title_i18n.it: Trovi una scatola strana mentre fai le pulizie di primavera.
title_i18n.ko: 봄맞이 대청소를 하던 중 이상한 상자를 발견한다.
title_i18n.pl: Znajdujesz dziwną skrzynkę podczas wiosennych porządków.
title_i18n.ru: Вы находите странную коробку во время весенней уборки.
title_i18n.zh: 你在春季大扫除时发现了一个奇怪的盒子。
